trap.label: falso amigo eventually
trap.wrong: Do away of an old rule.
trap.right: Do away with an old rule.
trap.why: O brasileiro usa of/de por analogia ao português. Em inglês, do away with = eliminar.

mcq.q: The proposal is solid ___ and large.

fix.wrong: They did away of the rule.
fix.right: They did away with the rule.

fix.wrong: By and large the proposal is solid.
fix.right: By and large, the proposal is solid.
We do away with the policy.

rewrite.prompt: Use do away with: “They eliminated the rule.”
rewrite.answer: They did away with the rule.

rewrite.prompt: Use By and large: “In general, the proposal is solid.”
rewrite.answer: By and large, the proposal is solid.

rewrite.prompt: Use do away with: “Let’s eliminate the form.”
rewrite.answer: Let’s do away with the form.
